observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment authority evaluator and session coordination projection

observed_workflow.held_claim_scope_at_preflight: six repo-relative paths on the same worktree and branch

outcome.verified_change: When the same session holds a path-scoped claim on the requested worktree and branch but the write preflight asks for a broader scope, the evaluator now reports own-claim-does-not-cover-requested-scope and recommends narrowing the operation or extending that session's claim. The exact path scope remains eligible.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The original deferral was caused by a mismatch between the requested whole-worktree scope and the six-path claim. It was not an owner-approval requirement. This one workflow does not establish a recurring burden rate.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A path-scoped claim does not explain why a broader write preflight is deferred
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment authority preflight and claim scope matching
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authenticated session recorded one generic coordination defer while its current claim was path-scoped and the request covered the whole worktree; a later exact path preflight was allowed.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: One observed workflow; recurrence across sessions is not established.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Distinguish an own-claim coverage mismatch from missing ownership, and recommend narrowing the requested scope or extending the same session's claim without requesting approval or transfer.
not_measured: recurrence across independent sessions or repositories
agent time or tool calls spent resolving the mismatch
effect on integration correctness or long-term coordination burden

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The authority result is one observed coordination event and one later exact-scope evaluator response.
The new status and next step were verified by unit tests; no post-change live invocation of a deliberately mismatched scope was performed.
No agent approval or transfer was required in this workflow, but this does not measure future intervention reduction.
